@@ common_orcs
Common Orcs fear the sun and make their dwellings in cavern beneath the mountains. Their myriad tribes prey upon the worl of men, often prompted merely by a greed for plunder.

@@ hysical_haracter
Build: Heavy, with thick hides, short legs, and long, thin arm They have grotesque, fanged faces and random hair growt Males and females average 65 pounds. Coloring: Black or grey hair, black or reddish-brown eyes, an deep grey or black hides. Endurance: Tremendous. They can travel for 2 days withou sleep. +20 to exhaustion points (see Section 22.3). Height: Males and females average 4'. Lifespan: Indefinite; certainly hundreds of years, but the natur of their warlike life permits few to live past the age of 50. Resistance: +30 DB and RR bonuses versus heat and col attacks. Special Abilities: Common Orcs sleep during daylight hour although they need sleep only once every 3 days (more often t restore Power Points). Common Orcish vision in most darknes is as good as a Man’s during the height of day. When there i barely any light (cloudy, moonless nights; upper cavern dungeons), Common Orcs can see at least 50' perfectly an fairly well up to 100'. In absolute darkness, they can see 10’

@@ ulture
Clothing & Decoration: Skins, leathers, and metal armor crude, but well made and effective. Fears & Inabilities: Natural sunlight and deep, running water. I full daylight, they only have 60% of normal activity eac round; in artificial or magical daylight, they only have 80% o normal activity each round. Lifestyle: Bred as laborers and warriors, Orcs respect power an terror above all things. They join and cooperate in substanti groups only when led by a “focused will,” some overwhelm ingly strong individual. To them, politics equates with forc and separate Orc tribes often war. Inter-tribal cannibalism is th norm. They are, however, quite skilled. Their smiths rival those o the Dwarves and Elves and, although the items they produc lack beauty in form, they are exceptionally effective. Orcs ar also fine healers, despite their lack of concern for scarring. Marriage Pattern: Common Orcs do not marry; they breed. The females live together in secluded areas which are nor- mally accessible only to the strongest males. In addition, the females are receptive only to the fiercest and most attrac- tive males. This results in the strongest offspring. The many young are kept together and raised jointly by all the female Common Orcs. Religion: Most Orcs worship Darkness and power.

@@ ther_actors
Demeanor: Common Orcs are cruel, jealous, petty, ambitious, selfish, and suspicious. They are almost always uncomfort- able and, aside from mealtime or battle, are never happy or at peace.
